reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism (strain-accelerated nanosegregation of embrittling elements to grain boundaries) with a clear intervention (pre-existing Cr-rich precipitates as sinks) and a well-defined falsification experiment, directly addressing the toughness loss in single-phase HEAs. Hypothesis B conflates multiple mechanisms (fcc-to-hcp transformation and nanosegregation) without a controlled intervention to isolate their effects, making it less decisive and more speculative for the stated single-phase system.
